testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a selected file name after changing the file-list selection: git/oblikovati-workspace/oblikovati-rust/target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:309:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a selected file name after changing the file-list selection ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its part file and subfolder ✔ When the user selects `ExistingPart.opd` in the file list ✔ Then the file is highlighted and its name appears in the file name field ✔ When the user selects the subfolder with a single click ✔ Then the subfolder is highlighted without opening ✔ And the file name field still displays the selected part file name ✔ When the user clicks empty space in the file list ✔ Then no file or folder is highlighted ✔ And the file name field still displays the part file name ✔ When the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the new unsaved part remains active
